name: Kyokujitsu ni Kokoro Arawasu Gojitsudan - Manshuu no Fuyu
original_name: 旭日ニ戀露ス 後日譚・満州の冬
source:
A fandisc after story to the indie game "Kyokujitsu ni Kokoro Arawasu".
Several years after the Russo-Japanese War, several years after the happy ending of the main characters.
[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE130529.html]English DLsite[/url]]
translation:
独立游戏《在旭日下吐露真心》的粉丝碟后日谈。

故事发生在日俄战争结束、主角们迎来幸福结局的数年后。

[改编自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE130529.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
